title: Bring network devices up
summary: Activate one or more network interfaces, bringing them up to establish connectivity.

steps.explain: Use sudo to bring the specified network interfaces up. Replace <INTERFACE> with the name of the interface (e.g., eth0, wlan0).

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the network interface to bring up.

rollback.explain: To undo this, bring the interface down again.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the network interface to bring down.

warnings: Bringing an interface down or up may temporarily disconnect you from the network.
